svg.aria-label: How Claude Code gets into a session: the inventory pins a Claude Code version and an image tag; the agentbox role renders a root-owned Containerfile, builds it rootless as agent through Squid only when the tag does not exist yet, checks the image, and renders the tag into the launcher, which runs it with --pull=never. Updating means bumping both values; the old tag stays for going back.
svg.text: How Claude Code gets into a session
tutner.agent_sandbox: installed when the image is built, pinned, never updated in place
builds and runs as agent; the recipe belongs to root

g.text: owned by root, rendered by the role
agent builds from it, cannot change it
is the tag in agent's storage?
a tag names exactly one build
tagged localhost/agentbox:0.2.0, labelled with the build hash
apt-get install git ripgrep bubblewrap socat …
Claude Code installed as root under /usr: dev cannot change it
every build step goes through it
and is not baked into the image
so build sources must be on
the build runs as agent, like a session
older build, kept for going back
a wrong image fails the run
the tag is rendered into it
runs claude from the image; user dev cannot update it

svg.text: four steps, and the old image stays

g.text: a new tag, never a reused one
0.2.0-cc2.x.y is not in storage: build it

svg.text: Set both values back. The tag exists with a matching hash, so nothing is built and the launcher names it again.
The recipe hash no longer matches the existing tag, and the role fails instead of rebuilding it.
